acceptance: A forge-cli test runs forge build and gets an unknown-subcommand error, and asserts forge --help lists neither wasm-build, wasm-upload, ship nor build; it fails before the change.
forge new offers no wasm template to a customer; a test asserts the listed templates.
forge-control-plane's refusal for an unmarked tree with no forge.lock names pushing dialect source, not forge build, and a test asserts the message.
forge-cli README.md describes the new/check/test/push loop and mentions no customer build.
dev/up-full.sh --release still deploys the portal (forge dev and the hidden ship path still work), shown in the step's evidence.
author: rory

gaps.description: forge dev shelled out to the removed 'build' alias (dev.rs:226); it now calls wasm-build, so dropping the alias does not break forge dev
forge new --template workspace without --dialect still scaffolded the raw wasm workspace; it now refuses and the wasm tree is the unlisted 'wasm-workspace'
the CP refusal reword grew src/git/reconcile/push.rs past its code-structure baseline (1112 > 1109); message reflowed to three lines, file back at 1109

a cold up-full.sh --release ship of the portal is refused by the harness commit fence: the build regenerates four forge-lang-generated crates in forge-portal-web (domains/billing/src/lib.rs, three jgen/mod.rs, last committed 2026-10-08) because forge-lang codegen moved since, so the ship-stamp is not lock-only
gaps.note: the drift predates IP-3 and is in forge-portal-web, outside this plan's landing block; evidence is a base-CLI vs lane-CLI build of the same portal tree producing the same regeneration, plus a warm up-full.sh --release converging the portal with the lane CLI; it is named in the report for a forge-portal-web follow-up

statement: The customer CLI hands over no toolchain (D-106): forge build is not a verb, forge --help lists no wasm verb (wasm-build, wasm-upload and ship stay callable, hidden, for forge dev and the portal's ship), forge new --list offers only the dialect workspace, the control plane's refusal of an unmarked tree with no forge.lock names pushing dialect source under .forge-interpret instead of forge build, and the forge-cli README teaches new/check/test/push.
